text.tspan: SSH not working? Read the error, then go from the outside in
Reachability Analyzer: which component blocks the path?
get-console-output / screenshot: kernel panic, fsck, disk full
Side doors when SSH is dead (bottom row). Inside: df -h; df -i; systemctl status sshd; sshd -t; ss -tlnp | grep :22;
ls -ld ~/.ssh (700) and authorized_keys (600). System check failed = AWS host → stop/start. Instance check failed = your OS.
